title: Oil prices hold near $105 per barrel as Trump eases sanctions on Russian fuel
summary: Oil prices fell on Tuesday after increasing nearly $2 a barrel the previous session. Concerns over energy supply disruptions from ongoing conflicts in the Middle East influenced market sentiment. Meanwhile, US sanctions on Russian fuel were temporarily lifted, allowing for additional diesel supply. OPEC revised its demand growth forecast downward, indicating overcapacity in the market.

summary: WASHINGTON: More than one-third of Pakistan’s population faces overlapping deprivations in health, education and living standards, according to the United Nations Development Prog­ramme’s (UNDP) Multidimensional Pov­er­ty Index (MPI) released on Monday. title: Sarah, first Zimbabwean female umpire in Women's T20 WC, passes away at 36
